parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google la describen como profesional, paciente y puntual, con un talento para capturar emociones espontáneas junto a tomas posadas elegantes, y para crear la atmósfera correcta antes de que la cámara empiece a disparar.

items.quote: Sasha was wonderful to work with for both our engagement and courthouse wedding. These were deeply meaningful moments for us, and she captured them so beautifully. From candid emotions to posed shots, every image feels natural, elegant.

I'm so happy with the exceptional job and care we received; my family is thrilled. From our initial contact to the stunning photos, you truly shine. Thank you for taking beautiful pictures of my family.
She is absolutely AMAZING! Sasha has an incredible eye for detail and a talent for setting the mood and creating the perfect atmosphere for stunning photos.
